summary: Verify and export explicitly declared package resources

delivery.outcome: Declare package resources explicitly, include safe resource bytes in sdist/wheel/source fingerprint, verify/export them with manifestv2 while preserving v1 readers for resource-free packages. Prove actual NL module standalone export without manual JSON copy; independently merge, release/preserve owned checkout.
nonGoals: Change native algorithms, C ABI, runtime dependencies/platforms, production consumers or measured performance guarantees.
Discover arbitrary package files, build-script I/O/environment, authenticate publishers or promise transactional exports/hot reload.
Release/deploy, migrate consumer source, change protected policy or complete Docs adoption.

architecture.decision: Optional resources list uses canonical package-relative POSIX file paths under src/artifact-package; reject duplicates, symlinks, escape, reserved native/manifest/code destinations before compilers. Reuse private path validation across builder/runtime. Build_ext get_source_files includes declared resources in sdist and run copies them into fresh wheel; append unique source inputs to digest. Emit sorust.artifacts/v2 with resources only for opted-in consumers; old v1 without resources remains supported and old runtime rejects v2. Verify/export includes declared resource hashes and snapshot rechecks. Add --manifest-resources mode to the pinned NL pilot; no manual sidecar copy in that mode, verify drift rejection and run the same original conformance/parity tests.
dataChanges: sorust.artifacts/v2 requires resources list; source digest includes declared resource bytes. v1 format emitted unchanged without resources.
architecture.rollback: Protected reviewed revert; new readers support old manifests, v2 consumers require resource-aware Sorust pin and must not downgrade; preserve old dist, baseline/validation/pilot receipts and ignored data.

validation.evidence: Safe/malformed/missing/link/reserved-path inputs rejected before compilation; optional and legacy manifest behavior; v2 drift/missing/duplicate/path/parent-symlink rejection and snapshot-before-output; actual consumer sdist/wheel/resource-only rebuild/export/minimal-runtime binary imports without package-data declarations.

Full suites/final artifact install/export/hash smoke. Pinned actual NL module all3 modes/original8conformance functions each, resource automatically exported and audit rejects drift; no new speed claim. Real old reader rejects v2, new reader accepts legacy v1. Canonicalv18 metadata/index/source receipts.
Local and required remote gates, frozen independent approval/merge; postmerge smoke, owner CAS release, preserved exact checkout cleanup/audit.
